newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian peso drops in sluggish post-Easter trade.
newsitem.headline: Colombian peso drops in sluggish post-Easter trade.

text.p: Colombia's peso dropped 2.9 pesos to 1,061.7 against the dollar in markets that saw less than half the daily average currency transactions, interbank dealers said.
"The market barely woke up after Easter week," one dealer said in reference to the sluggish day's trade in a short-month end session.
Traders said some petro-dollars flowed into the markets and there was some demand from the public sector and multinationals looking to send profits abroad.
Dealers reported 219 trades worth a total $88.2 million, compared to a daily average of about $180 million. The peso climbed to a high of 1,060 and sank to a low of 1,062.
